environment_setting: Suburban community in Country B, where gun ownership is common and there is a growing concern about illegal firearm transactions.
norm_base: Any person Sell or transfer handguns or handgun ammunition to juveniles (under 18) Fine and/or imprisonment up to 1 year

character_profile.name: John Carter
character_profile.goal: increase profits for his gun shop

legitimate.legitimate_action: Refusing to sell or transfer handguns or ammunition to juveniles
legitimate.benefits: Avoids legal trouble, maintains reputation as a law-abiding business owner
legitimate.costs: Potential loss of sales from underage buyers or their families

illegal.illegal_action: Selling a handgun and ammunition to a 16-year-old without verifying their age
illegal.costs: Fine and/or imprisonment up to 1 year if caught, damage to reputation

character_profile.name: Mike Thompson
character_profile.goal: obtain a handgun for personal use

legitimate.legitimate_action: Not attempting to purchase a handgun illegally
legitimate.benefits: Avoids legal trouble, maintains a clean record
legitimate.costs: Unable to obtain a handgun, frustration

illegal.illegal_action: Attempting to purchase a handgun from John Carter by lying about his age
illegal.benefits: Successfully obtaining a handgun for personal use
illegal.costs: Legal trouble if caught, potential fine or juvenile detention

character_profile.name: Sarah Miller
character_profile.goal: prevent illegal firearm transactions in her community

legitimate.legitimate_action: Reporting suspicious activity at John Carter's gun shop to the authorities
legitimate.benefits: Potentially preventing illegal firearm transactions, improving community safety
legitimate.costs: Time and effort spent gathering evidence and reporting, potential backlash from John Carter

illegal.illegal_action: Ignoring suspicious activity at John Carter's gun shop
illegal.benefits: Avoids conflict with John Carter, saves time and effort
illegal.costs: Moral guilt, potential harm to community safety if illegal transactions occur
